title: OPERATION COLD REVEILLE: SHOCK PROTOCOL
body: Establish immediate psychological dominance over autumn climate. Purge lingering comfortable habits acquired during October. The continental shell requires instantaneous thermal crystallization upon initial alarm sounding.
plainSummary: Get out of bed immediately. No warm showers. No lounging. The month starts now.
prohibitedActions: Remaining in bed for more than 45 seconds following alarm.
Adjustment of water mixer toward red/warm indicator.
sanctionedCountermeasures: Plunge hands into water containing at least three ice cubes.
100 brisk jumping jacks facing the official state portrait.

title: OPERATION STEAM QUARANTINE: CONDENSATION BAN
body: Eliminate domestic thermal indulgence and neutralize moisture-induced relaxation vectors. Bathing must be executed with abrupt mechanical efficiency in ambient conditions not exceeding 10 degrees Celsius.
plainSummary: Cold showers only. No lotions. No long baths. Clean yourself quickly and move on.
prohibitedActions: Application of body lotions or conditioning balms.
Browsing photographic media depicting tropical vacation destinations.
sanctionedCountermeasures: Conduct hygiene solely with coarse pumice bar.
Stare at the blank ceiling while counting down from 1,000 in prime numbers.

title: OPERATION GREYSCALE PURGE: VISUAL SENSORY DEPRIVATION
body: Deprive the central nervous system of hyper-stimulating visual saturation across all screens and hand-held appliances. Color saturation is an unnecessary neuro-chemical stimulant that compromises continental resolve.
plainSummary: Switch your phone to greyscale. Avoid stimulating content. Keep it boring on purpose.
prohibitedActions: Unlocking handheld devices during bedroom hours.
Engaging with short-form algorithmic video streams.
sanctionedCountermeasures: Shift all digital displays to monochrome / 1-bit display mode.
Read technical manuals regarding cold-rolled steel tolerances.

title: THE SOVEREIGN WALNUT VIGIL: POCKET DEXTERITY
body: Test physical dexterity and conscious presence through pocket custody of a fragile walnut. The physical preservation of the nut symbolizes the uncracked resolve of the sovereign citizen.
plainSummary: Carry a walnut in your pocket all day. Don't crack it. Don't lose it. Just carry it.
prohibitedActions: Cracking, biting, or scratching the assigned pocket walnut.
Placing hands inside pockets during public assembly without immediate purpose.
sanctionedCountermeasures: Inspect the shell hourly for structural integrity.
Recite the Walnut Oath upon encountering any state official.

title: [DRAFT] OPERATION TRACTOR GAZETTE: ALGORITHMIC ISOLATION
body: Citizen internet traffic will be routed solely through agricultural tractor schematics and municipal grain reports. Draft awaiting General Staff ratification.
plainSummary: Only read about tractors online today. Everything else is off-limits.
prohibitedActions: Accessing any URL ending in .social or .stream.
sanctionedCountermeasures: Manual transcription of tractor gear ratios into notebook.
